notes: The marginal alternative rendering and the manuscript note are read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The second that (t023) is added: אֲשֶׁר governs only the first phrase, and the coordinated rearguard phrase is a bare prepositional phrase with no morpheme to carry a subordinator (rule 55).
The first את takes the appositional even because it stands on the appositive itself (rule 16).
